article.name: Roblox Plus
article.title: Roblox Plus
article.body:
Roblox Plus is a new subscription that offers savings on activities users already value, making the everyday Roblox experience more rewarding. Roblox Plus will be available globally on April 30, 2026.

With the launch of Roblox Plus, Roblox Premium memberships will no longer be available for purchase. For more information, please see the Roblox Premium Membership Help Center article.

 

What are the Roblox Plus benefits?

Roblox Plus subscribers will receive a distinct logo on their profiles, along with the following benefits: 

  • Smarter Way to Spend: Subscribers receive an immediate 10% discount on in-game items, avatars, and more.*
  • Double Discount: Starting on a subscriber’s third consecutive month, the discount increases to 20%, rewarding consistent membership.*
  • Access to free Private Servers: Subscribers will have access to free private servers across all supported games. Private servers allow players to create and manage their own instance of a game, giving them more control over who they play with.
    • Starting on September 24, this benefit will transition to include one free private server per game. If you currently have multiple free private servers in a single game, you will keep only one. Any extra free servers will start to expire on September 24.
      • Note: Any private servers purchased separately outside of your subscription are entirely unaffected. They will continue to run and renew through their original payment method.
  • Transfer Robux for Free: Subscribers can send Robux directly to other users without any platform fees. Sending is an exclusive Plus subscriber benefit, while recipients do not need to be on Plus.**
  • Unlimited Trading: Trade Limited items as many times as you want. For a limited time, users in the United States can make up to 2 free trades per month without Roblox Plus; Roblox Plus gives unlimited trades.
  • Resell Avatar Items: Resell Limited items you have bought from Roblox or other creators.
  • Publish and Sell Avatar Items: To publish and maintain avatar assets on the Marketplace, Roblox requires users and groups to be subscribed to Roblox Plus or a Premium 1000/2200 Membership.
  • Expand your game’s audience: Fulfill one of the criteria required for your game to be seen by users of all ages.

* Discounts do not apply to items over 1M Robux, items that are resold, ads credit, avatar item publishing fees, or group fees (name or creation).

** To ensure safe transfers, all users involved must be age-verified and 18+ to send or receive. For users under 18, a parent or caregiver must approve Robux transfers. Safety requirements may be updated to reflect regional regulations.

 

Does Roblox Plus come with a monthly stipend of Robux?

Roblox Plus is a benefits-only monthly subscription with no monthly stipend. 

We also offer multiple optional bundles—Plus 500, Plus 1000, and Plus 2000. Each bundle includes:

  • A Roblox Plus subscription.
  • Either 500, 1000, or 2000 Robux (depending on the bundle), recurring monthly.

These bundles are a convenient way to pay once for both Roblox Plus and monthly Robux, rather than purchasing them separately.

 

How is Roblox Plus different from Roblox Premium?

Roblox Plus and Roblox Premium offer different subscription benefits:

For a limited time, users in the United States can make up to 2 free trades each month without a subscription. Roblox Plus and legacy Premium give unlimited trades.

 

Where can I purchase Roblox Plus? 

Roblox Plus will be available for purchase on the following platforms/payment methods:

  • Web/Desktop via Credit/Debit, PayPal, and Gift Card Credits
    • You can purchase Roblox Plus using Gift Card Credits directly from the Redeem Roblox Gift Cards and Codes page
  • Apple via Apple App Store purchases
  • Android via Google Play Store purchases 

If you're using Roblox on a mobile device, please note that Roblox Plus is available on the latest version of the app. If you don't see the option to subscribe, update your app via your app store.

At this time, Roblox Plus is not available for purchase from the Samsung Galaxy Store downloaded Roblox App, PCGDK, Microsoft Handheld, Quest, or other consoles.

 

Who can purchase Roblox Plus?

Roblox Plus is available to all users in Roblox supported countries, with the exception of users located in Vietnam using the Roblox-VNG app. 

 

Is it possible to buy Roblox Plus while an existing Premium Membership is still active?

Yes, you are able to have both a Roblox Plus and a Premium Membership subscription active at the same time.

 

 

Managing Your Roblox Plus Subscription

You can find your active Roblox Plus subscription by navigating to Settings > Subscriptions. On this page you can: 

  • View your renewal date 
  • View expiration date
  • Update your payment method

 

Can I transfer my membership to another account?

No. Roblox Plus subscriptions are non-transferable. Please ensure you are logged into the correct account before subscribing.

 

What happens if my renewal fails? 

Most subscription renewals are completed within 24 hours of the renewal date. In the event that the subscription is unable to be renewed for any reason, further renewal attempts will be made over the next 72 hours. If we still cannot renew your subscription, your subscription will then be cancelled.

 

Canceling Your Roblox Plus Subscription

How do I cancel Roblox Plus? 

You can cancel your recurring Roblox Plus any time before the renewal date. If you cancel, you will continue to receive benefits for the remainder of the time you have already paid for.

  1. Go to Settings > Subscriptions.
  2. Find the subscription you want to cancel and click the arrow (>) to view details.
  3. Select Cancel Renewal and follow the prompts.

 

I can’t log in to cancel!

If you cannot access your account to cancel your subscription, contact us immediately with the username of the subscribed account. Note that cancellation requests must be received before the renewal date.

 

I did not cancel on time! Can I get a refund? 

Purchases of Roblox Plus are final and non-refundable. You can cancel Roblux Plus at any time and have access to your benefits until the billing cycle ends.

 

 

Roblox Plus Referrals

Plus Referrals gives eligible Roblox Plus subscribers a simple way to invite friends and community members to try Plus. When a new user subscribes through a referral link and makes their first payment, both the referrer and the new subscriber receive 100 Robux.

 

How it works

  • Open the Roblox Plus page and select Invite.
  • Copy your unique referral link and share it on or off Roblox.
  • When a new user subscribes to Roblox Plus through your link and makes their first payment, the referral is recorded.
  • After the standard 21-day hold, both accounts receive 100 Robux.

 

Eligibility and reward details

  • Referrers must be paid Roblox Plus subscribers in good standing and must have made their first payment.
  • Referred users must be new Roblox Plus subscribers.
  • Each referred account can receive the referral reward once.
  • Referral rewards are credited directly to the account balance.
  • Referral Robux can be used across Roblox, including for avatar items, in-game items, private servers, and eligible Ads Manager purchases.
  • Referral Robux is not eligible for DevEx and cannot be exchanged for USD.
  • For more information, see the Roblox Plus Referral Program Terms.

 

Where to find your referral link

To invite a friend, go to the home page, open Roblox Plus from the side menu, and select Invite. Your link can be copied and shared with friends, fans, or your broader community.
